items.prompt: Two shape-compatible price and quantity arrays use different instrument orders. What will NumPy normally do?

options.text: Detect the wrong instruments from the numbers
options.why: An unlabeled array does not carry the business identity check.
The array shape/type mechanism does not enforce financial units.

options.text: Sort both arrays by the missing labels
options.why: There are no labels here for NumPy to sort.

options.text: Compute without detecting that business mismatch
options.why: The caller must validate labels, order, timestamps and units.

items.explanation: Shape compatibility is only one contract check. Business alignment and units need their own explicit evidence.
